style_summary: Realistic figures on pale gray-white ground, their torsos constructed from irregular black handwriting, with a compact heavy black headline and sparse red handwritten marks.

environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Source identities and content to exclude
environment_variables.SUBJECT: Photographic person, pose, essential prop and selective red accent
environment_variables.BODY_TEXT: Exact manifesto words constructing the body silhouette
environment_variables.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Semantic lettering shape and composition for each ratio
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: Pose that the letter-built torso must follow
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: Single practical prop plus one small red subject detail
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: Quiet negative space around the figure
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: Spare red underline, circle or short stroke
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: Exposed photographic head, limbs and remaining garments around the letter torso

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] The central visual trick is a human body constructed from irregular black hand-lettered words. Remove the photographic torso and upper garment and replace that area with background-colored negative space filled by letters; the collective outer edges of the letters create the silhouette. It must not look like text printed on a white shirt, a rectangular sign, or a tattoo.
[CORE] Keep the head, exposed arms, hands and lower legs photographic and anatomically connected to the letter-built silhouette, so the figure remains one coherent person.

[CORE] Body lettering is slender, elongated, single-stroke black felt-tip handwriting, NOT bold brush lettering or a heavy display font. Stroke width roughly one fifteenth of letter height. Narrow irregular uppercase glyphs, varying heights and gently wavering baselines fit the body volume. Air between strokes is essential, every word legible.
[CORE] A pale gray-white seamless photographic ground with generous quiet negative space supports almost-black ink and very limited muted crimson accents; no rich scene or colorful graphic backdrop.

[CORE] A SMALL compact block of extra-bold wide uppercase sans-serif headline contrasts with the slender body handwriting. Keep headline clearly secondary to the figure, roughly a quarter of canvas width, with a short small crimson handwritten subline.
[FLEX] Shape word rows to express the case action: stretch, slope, compression or rhythm; choose emphasis words and row arrangement freely without changing exact wording.
[FLEX] Position the compact headline and figure for the aspect ratio and gesture, rather than always reproducing the source upper-left title and upright central body.
[FLEX] One spare red underline, circle or short stroke may focus the headline or action; red also appears in one small practical subject detail. Keep accents sparse.
source_content_to_avoid: The football player, raised-knee celebration and backward-shouting pose
American football, red cleats and football camp story
IT ALL STARTS HERE and the source motivational body wording
Hugh Freeze name, camp dates, schedule and footer logos
Any Nike or other brand mark, QR code, creator credit or platform watermark

visual_deconstruction.observed: Pale tall poster; small heavy headline upper left with red rough circle; huge photographic athlete at center-right; torso and shorts replaced by pale letter-filled negative silhouette; real head and limbs; minimal red footwear and football; small supporting information.
visual_deconstruction.transfer: Keep typographic anatomy, editorial hierarchy, sparse gray-white photographic treatment and red ink. Replace person, profession, pose and campaign copy. Schedule and sponsor footer are source content, not a requirement.

composition.hierarchy: Letter-built figure dominates; compact headline is secondary focal anchor; red handwritten subline is small. Preserve ample blank ground.
composition.portrait: Let the individual gesture dictate vertical movement, title placement and irregular text silhouette. Preserve complete head, hands and feet.
composition.landscape: Use lateral figure gesture or seated spread and place headline in a separate negative-space zone. Recompose instead of cropping.

typography.headline: Small compact extra-bold wide grotesk, no tall condensed giant headline; visually secondary to figure.
typography.body: Slender elongated single-stroke hand lettering; approximate stroke width 1/15 letter height, open internal spaces, irregular baselines; outer glyphs imply anatomy without a continuous white garment edge.
typography.secondary: Small muted crimson felt-tip handwriting, readable; no other printed copy.

color_palette.accent: Muted crimson red, under 8 percent of canvas
color_palette.photography: Restrained desaturated natural skin and materials

image_treatment.texture: Fine restrained photographic grain across pale ground and exposed photographic skin, with natural soft cutout edges; marker strokes have tiny organic edge irregularity. No grunge damage, halftone, fake paper tears or added blur.
image_treatment.lighting: Broad soft studio key, believable limb shading and faint grounding shadows; modest contrast, no glossy CGI finish.

design_rules: Construct anatomical silhouette with letters themselves, no fabric seams or shading under the words.
Keep all supplied copy exact and use no extra words.
Maintain one plausible connected body, with hands and feet distinct from letter strokes.
Let posture influence word geometry and adapt both ratios deliberately.
Use only necessary case props and keep facial detail, hands and text unobstructed.
do: Use body-shaped negative space as the lettering field.
Vary word scale according to meaning and pose.
Keep headline compact and use open pale margins.
avoid: No slogan T-shirt or rectangular text panel over a person.
No football content, source identity or copied source text.
No repeated generic upright figure across all cases.
No extra fingers, severed-looking limbs, unreadable word soup or unnecessary microcopy.
negative_prompt: No football, no source slogan or names, no brands or logos, no white slogan shirt, no rectangular text sticker, no torso photograph underneath letters, no colored torso panel, no random letters or repeated copy, no extra limbs, no dismemberment, no busy background, no large red shapes, no tiny fake legal text. No heavy brush body lettering, no solid white clothing silhouette, no giant condensed headline, no dirty grunge floor.

values.SUBJECT: An adult woman contemporary dancer with natural dark hair tied back, in an expressive standing side-bend, one arm curves overhead toward the left and the other opens sideways. Both feet grounded, one leg extended sideways with a small crimson ankle wrap; exposed arms, head, and lower legs are photographed.
values.BODY_TEXT: BREATHE DEEP REACH WIDE FIND YOUR SPACE
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Stretch REACH and WIDE across the bending ribcage; narrow the words at the waist. Create an airy crescent of blank space inside the arm and torso bend. Portrait: figure rises in a sweeping arc on the left, compact headline in the open upper-right corner. Landscape: wide arm-and-leg gesture travels left to right, with headline nested in the open side of the arc. Typography constructs the torso and upper-thigh silhouette, never the arms.

values.SUBJECT: An adult male climber in a studio-isolated sideways reaching pose, one extended arm reaches diagonally up-right to a single small crimson climbing hold at the frame edge; other arm bent outward for balance, legs spread with one knee bent. Only two minimal neutral holds under the feet suggest a wall, with no landscape or ropes. Face, arms and lower legs photographic.
values.BODY_TEXT: STAY CALM FIND BALANCE REACH FURTHER
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The letter-body follows the diagonal lean and tension of the reach: STAY CALM compressed near the shoulders, FIND BALANCE expanding across the tilted ribcage, REACH FURTHER stretching through waist and upper thighs. Preserve clear top-to-bottom reading order. Portrait: climber travels from lower-left to upper-right, headline bottom-left. Landscape: stretch the reach farther sideways, headline left of torso. Clear grip on the hold, believable limb joints; text does not replace arms or hands.

values.SUBJECT: An adult woman drummer with short hair, seated at a single snare drum on a simple tripod stand; two photographic hands hold exactly two wooden drumsticks, one raised and one poised over the snare. Face tilted attentively toward the drum. Photographic lower legs and feet wear plain black shoes; a small crimson wristband is the only vivid accessory.
values.BODY_TEXT: LISTEN CLOSE PLAY WITH YOUR WHOLE HEART
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The seated letter-body is compact, with LISTEN CLOSE small near shoulders, PLAY WITH in syncopated rows across torso, YOUR WHOLE HEART expanding over the bent upper thighs. Maintain one connected sitter; keep snare offset so it does not cover the lettering. Portrait: figure in lower-middle, compact headline high with generous silence between. Landscape: seated figure at left, angled sticks point toward compact headline on right; use empty space like a musical rest.

values.SUBJECT: An adult male ceramic artist with slightly gray hair seated leaning forward at a small pottery wheel, two photographed clay-covered hands carefully cupping one unfinished vessel. Head looks down. Exposed forearms and lower legs are photographic; a small crimson cloth hangs from the wheel stand. No workshop setting and no apron covering the typographic body. Keep wheel equipment and floor restrained and clean, with clay only on hands and vessel; show both feet completely within frame.
values.BODY_TEXT: SLOW DOWN FEEL MORE MAKE WITH CARE
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Form a rounded, compressed letter torso echoing the curved vessel: SLOW DOWN near the shoulder slope, FEEL MORE across upper chest, MAKE WITH CARE shaping abdomen and bent thigh. Keep a pale gap between forearms and body so the hands and process remain readable. Portrait: low seated figure with compact headline above and to left, generous right-side breathing room. Landscape: figure on right leans inward toward wheel in center, headline on far left; rounded letter contours echo clay without becoming a decorative pot-shaped text blob.
